mapper.insert: insert into task ( task_no, project_no, task_title, task_content, assigned_member_no, task_status, task_order, task_start, task_end, task_category, task_priority, task_progress, task_writer_no, task_ctime, task_utime ) values ( #{taskNo}, #{projectNo}, #{taskTitle}, #{taskContent}, #{assignedMemberNo}, nvl(#{taskStatus}, 'TODO'), nvl(#{taskOrder}, 1), #{taskStart}, #{taskEnd}, #{taskCategory}, nvl(#{taskPriority}, '보통'), nvl(#{taskProgress}, 0), #{taskWriterNo}, systimestamp, null )
mapper.select: select t.task_no as taskNo, t.project_no as projectNo, t.task_title as taskTitle, t.task_content as taskContent, t.assigned_member_no as assignedMemberNo, t.task_status as taskStatus, t.task_order as taskOrder, t.task_start as taskStart, t.task_end as taskEnd, t.task_category as taskCategory, t.task_priority as taskPriority, t.task_progress as taskProgress, t.task_writer_no as taskWriterNo, t.task_ctime as taskCtime, t.task_utime as taskUtime from task t where t.project_no = #{projectNo} order by t.task_status asc, t.task_order asc

select t.task_no as taskNo, t.project_no as projectNo, t.task_title as taskTitle, t.task_content as taskContent, t.assigned_member_no as assignedMemberNo, u_assignee.name as assignedMemberName, u_assignee.dept_name as assignedMemberDept, t.task_status as taskStatus, t.task_order as taskOrder, t.task_start as taskStart, t.task_end as taskEnd, t.task_category as taskCategory, t.task_priority as taskPriority, t.task_progress as taskProgress, t.task_writer_no as taskWriterNo, u_writer.name as taskWriterName, t.task_ctime as taskCtime, t.task_utime as taskUtime from task t left join project_member pm_assignee on t.assigned_member_no = pm_assignee.project_member_no left join user_info u_assignee on pm_assignee.emp_no = u_assignee.emp_no inner join project_member pm_writer on t.task_writer_no = pm_writer.project_member_no inner join user_info u_writer on pm_writer.emp_no = u_writer.emp_no where t.task_no = #{taskNo}
mapper.update: update task set task_status = #{taskStatus}, task_order = #{taskOrder}, task_utime = systimestamp where task_no = #{taskNo}

update task set task_title = #{taskTitle}, task_content = #{taskContent}, assigned_member_no = #{assignedMemberNo}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, task_order = #{taskOrder}, task_start = #{taskStart}, task_end = #{taskEnd}, task_category = #{taskCategory}, task_priority = #{taskPriority}, task_progress = #{taskProgress}, task_utime = systimestamp where task_no = #{taskNo}
